heroDescription: Talk is a space for serious writing and real conversations. No algorithms decide what you see. No ads interrupt your reading. Just a community of writers and readers who care about words that matter.
feature1Desc: A clean editor that puts your words at the center. No algorithms, no ads, no notifications. Just you and your words.
feature2Desc: Every post starts a conversation. Thoughtful comments from people who read what you write because they want to, not because an algorithm told them to.
feature3Desc: Your own site with your content. You control the access, the look, who reads. No algorithms decide for you.
ctaDesc: Talk is where serious words meet real readers. No algorithms. No noise. Just you and your blank page.

termsSection4Text: We respect your privacy. Only basic data is collected to operate the platform, and we do not share your personal information with third parties without your consent.
termsSection5Text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be notified of important changes via email.
